concepts.heading: Sternberg's Triangular Theory of Love
concepts.alt: A guide holding a large triangle with a heart at each corner
concepts.plain: One well-known idea says love is made of three parts.

concepts.heading: The Three Components
concepts.alt: Each holding one item: a warm mug, a small flame and a golden key
concepts.plain: The three parts are closeness, passion and commitment.

concepts.heading: Seven Types of Love
concepts.alt: A guide holding a fan of seven differently coloured heart cards
concepts.plain: Mixing the three in different amounts gives seven kinds of love.

concepts.heading: The Natural Ebb and Flow
concepts.alt: A guide standing calmly at the shore watching waves roll in and out
concepts.plain: All three go up and down over time. That is normal.

concepts.heading: ENM Application
concepts.plain: Different relationships can be strong in different parts, and that is fine.

checks.prompt: What are Sternberg's three components of love?
checks.explanation: Intimacy, passion and commitment. Intimacy is the feeling of closeness, and it sits alongside passion and commitment.

checks.prompt: What does Sternberg's model say about the three components over time?
checks.explanation: All three fluctuate. Sternberg's model normalizes what many people experience but don't discuss: all three components fluctuate over time.

1c3508e1-2235-4ed4-9507-fe1d70478d81.takeaway: Love has three parts: closeness, passion and commitment. Each one rises and falls over time.

concepts.heading: Gottman's 6 Hours a Week
concepts.alt: A guide holding a wall clock with a heart in the centre
concepts.plain: Small daily and weekly habits, about six hours a week in total, keep couples close.

concepts.heading: The Daily Rituals
concepts.alt: Two guides hugging goodbye at a doorway, D holding a lunch bag
concepts.plain: Daily: a real goodbye, a real hello, a little thanks and some affection.

concepts.heading: The Weekly Rituals
concepts.alt: Two guides sharing a candlelit dinner date
concepts.plain: Weekly: a two-hour date and a check-in on how you two are doing.

concepts.heading: Why Small Rituals Matter More Than Grand Gestures
concepts.alt: A guide dropping small hearts one at a time into a glass jar
concepts.plain: Lots of small good moments beat one big gesture.

concepts.heading: Adapting for ENM
concepts.alt: A guide looking at a big wall calendar with coloured hearts on different days
concepts.plain: With several partners the hours add up, so plan them honestly.

checks.prompt: How much time do Gottman's connection rituals total each week?
checks.explanation: About 6 hours. Gottman's daily and weekly connection rituals add up to about six hours a week.

checks.after: Why Small Rituals Matter More Than Grand Gestures
checks.explanation: Through frequent, small positive moments. Gottman's research consistently shows that relationship satisfaction is built through frequent, small positive interactions rather than occasional large ones.

a2ffbf66-34a1-4502-8a17-9cb2fd50774f.takeaway: About six hours a week of small rituals keeps a relationship strong.

concepts.heading: Intimacy Beyond Sex
concepts.alt: Two guides sitting close, sharing a pair of headphones and smiling
concepts.plain: Intimacy means closeness, and sex is only one kind.

concepts.heading: The Multiple Dimensions of Intimacy
concepts.alt: A and B sharing a book while C and D stargaze beside them
concepts.plain: You can be close through feelings, ideas, touch, shared experiences and beliefs.

concepts.heading: Why Over-Emphasizing Sexual Intimacy Creates Fragility
concepts.alt: A guide balancing carefully on a one-legged stool
concepts.plain: If sex is your only way to feel close, the relationship is easier to shake.

concepts.heading: Intimacy in Everyday Moments
concepts.alt: Two guides reading in comfortable silence on the same sofa
concepts.plain: Quiet everyday moments can be the closest ones.

concepts.heading: ENM and Multi-Dimensional Intimacy
concepts.plain: Different partners can meet different needs for closeness.

concepts.heading: Self-Intimacy
concepts.alt: A guide writing in a journal with a cup of tea, content
concepts.plain: Being close to yourself counts too.

checks.after: Why Over-Emphasizing Sexual Intimacy Creates Fragility
checks.prompt: Why is relying mostly on sex for intimacy risky?
options: The relationship becomes vulnerable to disruption
checks.explanation: The relationship becomes vulnerable to disruption. Relationships that rely primarily on sexual connection for intimacy are vulnerable to disruption.

checks.prompt: Which dimension of intimacy is most overlooked?
checks.explanation: Intimacy with yourself. Perhaps the most overlooked dimension is intimacy with yourself.

9b5c119f-06d1-437a-a756-8c85408a5d47.takeaway: Closeness comes in many forms besides sex: feelings, ideas, shared experiences and quiet time.

concepts.heading: Sustainable Rhythms of Connection
concepts.alt: Two guides walking hand in hand along a long winding path
concepts.plain: Staying close for years is a daily choice, not a finish line.

concepts.heading: Creating Sustainable Systems
concepts.alt: Happily colour-coding a shared wall calendar
concepts.plain: Shared calendars and regular check-ins make it workable.

concepts.heading: The Challenge of Multiple Partnerships
concepts.alt: A guide carrying four different-sized cups on a tray, concentrating
concepts.plain: More relationships means more demands on your time and energy.

concepts.heading: Avoiding Burnout
concepts.alt: Slumped beside a phone showing a low battery icon
concepts.plain: Dreading plans and feeling drained are signs you have taken on too much.

concepts.heading: Intimacy During Life Transitions
concepts.plain: Illness, grief, moves and new babies shake every relationship. Adjust and be patient.

concepts.heading: Sternberg's Model Applied
concepts.alt: A guide watering one corner of a triangle-shaped planter
concepts.plain: When one part of love fades, give that part some attention.

concepts.heading: When Professional Support Helps
concepts.plain: If it stays hard, a couples therapist can help.

checks.prompt: Which is a sign you may be over-extended?
checks.explanation: Dreading time with partners. One sign of being over-extended is dreading time with partners rather than looking forward to it.

checks.prompt: What can you do when one component of love is waning?
checks.explanation: Intentionally nurture it. When you notice a component of love waning, you can intentionally nurture it.

d101bdd8-a775-4d78-93c4-5727c76bdce7.takeaway: Lasting closeness is a habit you keep choosing. Pace yourself and plan for it.
